text:
alex_ryan: Quick summary of the 7B/13B quantization bring-up runs + a few concrete recommendations for product. TL;DR: 7B q4_k is the best cost/perf sweet spot for chat; 13B int8 is the preferred option for high-precision use cases.

maria_ng: Nice — can you drop the numbers and any failure modes?

alex_ryan: Pasted the condensed bench run (eval suite = mixed QA+NLU+long-context tests, seq_len=2048 unless noted). Numbers are averaged across 3 seeds. Cost calc = infra token cost extrapolated to 1M output tokens (GPU amortized).

```
Model         | Quant  | QA acc | PPL  | TPS  | mem (GB/GPU) | $ / 1M toks
-----------------------------------------------------------------
7B fp16       | fp16   | 78.3%  | 12.1 | 1200 | 14.2         | $45
7B q4_k       | q4_k_m | 77.9%  | 12.5 | 2200 | 6.8          | $19
7B q4_0       | q4_0   | 77.0%  | 13.4 | 2400 | 5.6          | $15
13B fp16      | fp16   | 83.1%  | 9.6  |  800 | 27.5         | $85
13B int8      | int8   | 82.8%  | 9.9  | 1400 | 14.0         | $47
13B q4_k      | q4_k_m | 81.5%  |10.8  | 1600 | 12.0         | $39

Long-context (8k) spot-check:
13B fp16       | fp16   | 82.6%  | 10.4 | 350  | 30.1         | $210 (long ctx overhead)
13B int8       | int8   | 82.2%  | 10.7 | 620  | 15.3         | $115

Notes:
- Throughput measured with continuous batching enabled (mix of 1-4 concurrent requests).
- QA acc is our internal mixed-qa metric (higher is better).
- PPL is on held-out prosaic corpus.
```

maria_ng: Good to see q4_k keeps accuracy close to fp16. Any regressions by slice?

alex_ryan: Yes. Small regressions (~1.2-1.8% abs) on math/chain-of-thought style prompts for 7B q4_0 and 7B q4_k vs fp16. For 13B int8 regressions are <0.5% on the same slices. Dialogue coherence / hallucination checks were similar across variants.

samir: Operational notes? memory, perf cliffs?

jin-ops: Memory wise: 7B q4 variants fit easily in 16GB GPUs and allow denser packing (2-3x payloads per node). 13B int8 requires ~14-16GB but is stable. Cold-start KV-cache overhead is the main perf cliff for long-context 13B — watch seq>4k.

eval-bot: Deploy note: redwood-model-7b-q4k-stg rolled to staging cluster (tag: bringup-2026-03). Canary tests started against the eval harness.

product-jen: From a product POV we need a clear map: which default model for free tier, which for paid, and a short paragraph we can paste into the pricing doc. Also need rollout risk summary.

alex_ryan: Proposed mapping: 
- Default (free / trial): 7B q4_k — low cost, good latency, minor regressions on math (mitigation: fallback to 13B for tasks flagged by prod).
- Standard (paid): 13B int8 — much better QA headroom, acceptable cost/latency tradeoff for most apps.
- Premium: 13B fp16 or larger (on Dedicated) for customers who need best-in-class accuracy for reasoning-heavy workloads.

Rollout plan (short):
1) Canary 1% traffic -> 24h eval harness -> check: delta QA_acc <= 1.0% abs and latency P95 < configured SLOs.
2) If ok, 10% -> 48h with regression alerts on the top 50 prompt slices.
3) Gradual ramp to 50% and full if no alerts.

Routing policy snippet for automatic fallback (example):
```json
{
  "policy": "route_by_tier",
  "rules": [
    {"tier":"free","model":"7b-q4k","fallback":"13b-int8","fail_on_regression":true},
    {"tier":"paid","model":"13b-int8","fallback":"13b-fp16","fail_on_regression":false}
  ]
}
```

maria_ng: What about cost projections if we flip default to 7B q4_k across free+paid?

alex_ryan: Rough ballpark (based on current traffic distribution):
- Current default fp16 mix -> infra cost baseline = $X (internal reference).
- Switching default to 7B q4_k reduces serving infra spend by ~45-52% for inference tokens.
- If product wants to capture unit econ: per-request median cost drops from ~0.0045 -> ~0.0019.

samir: Risk callouts:
- Small accuracy regressions on reasoning/math slices for 7B variants — should be mitigated with fallback or prompt tagging.
- Long-context customers may see latency hits with 13B int8 unless we tune KV cache warming.
- Quantization-specific edge cases: occasional out-of-distribution token probability spikes; we saw 0.1% of responses requiring heuristics (truncate_probs) — flagged in eval harness.

product-jen: Thanks. For the pricing blurb can you add a one-liner about when we recommend upgrading?

alex_ryan: Suggested blurb: "We default to a cost-optimized 7B quantized model for general chat, and recommend upgrading to 13B (int8 or fp16) for tasks requiring higher factual accuracy or long-form reasoning."

jin-ops: Action items:
- @eval-bot -> run extended canary (72h) on the top 200 prompt slices and surface any >1.5% regressions.
- @alex_ryan -> add per-slice diffs to the staging dashboard.
- @product-jen -> decide fallback rule for math-heavy tasks (tagging vs always route to 13B).

eval-bot: Scheduled extended canary: 72h on bringup-2026-03. Will post alerts to #eng-ml/incidents if thresholds crossed.

alex_ryan: I'll push the short PR for routing policy and a one-paragraph doc for pricing. Expect it by EOD.

product-jen: Perfect. If the canary is clean we'll fold the change into next week's release. :thumbsup:

samir: Thanks team — nice concise data. Follow-up meeting if canary shows regressions.
